description: Compute full Great Circle & Rhumb Line aviation telemetry for an airport pair across 15 aircraft profiles (e.g. airbus-a350-900ulr, airbus-a350-1000, boeing-787-9, airbus-a321xlr, gulfstream-g650er, boeing-747-8): distance (km/nm/mi), headings, latitude-aware wind profile, 110m sovereign polygon overflight (with ISO-3 codes & corridor segments), solar window-seat recommendations, all-cabin CO2 emissions, aircraft range feasibility, reciprocal return flight delta, nearby corridors, and the canonical 3D globe URL.

aircraft.description: Optional aircraft profile ID, alias, or short name among 15 supported profiles (e.g. boeing-747-8, airbus-a350-900ulr, airbus-a350-1000, boeing-787-9, airbus-a321xlr, boeing-737-max-8, gulfstream-g650er, concorde). Defaults to Boeing 747-8.

cabin.description: Optional cabin class for per-passenger CO2 scaling. Defaults to economy.

departure_preset.description: Optional departure time window for solar/terminator seat analysis. If omitted, returns all 4 deterministic presets.

dest.description: 3-letter IATA airport code for the arrival airport (e.g. JFK, LHR).

origin.description: 3-letter IATA airport code for the departure airport (e.g. SIN, JFK).

name: get_flight_route_telemetry
